pakistan_alt: Captain Hamza Qureshi, fictional Pakistani convoy commander and Ark leader in his early thirties, strong jaw, trimmed black beard, brown skin, bright amused eyes under a utility cap; rugged pressure suit with restrained dark-green and white shoulder accents, no flag; a convoy of garishly painted cargo trucks lined up on a mountain pass, a frost-capped massif and a radio headset slung around his neck.
south_korea_alt: Seo Joon-ho, fictional South Korean Ark showrunner in his late twenties, boyish face, tousled dyed-chestnut hair, tired but gleeful eyes with faint dark circles; slim charcoal technical EVA suit with restrained white, red and blue shoulder accents, no flag; a control-room desk of glowing broadcast monitors and a half-built habitat stage behind him, a clipboard under one arm.
indonesia_alt: Bayu Santoso, fictional Indonesian Ark fleet-master in his early sixties, deep tan skin, close-cropped silver hair, a weathered smile and calm authority; weathered ivory EVA suit with restrained red and white shoulder accents, no flag; a signal flag lantern in one hand, a line of dust-sailed skiffs rocking at a rust-colored dock beneath a stack of cargo containers behind him.
saudi_arabia_alt: Khalid Al-Dosari, fictional Saudi Ark chief drilling engineer in his early forties, sun-darkened skin, neat black beard, focused dark eyes and a faint wry smile; durable sandstone and deep-green pressure suit with restrained white accents, no flag; a hard hat clipped to his harness, a towering drill derrick and a ribbon of dust blowing across a dune-sea at golden hour.
taiwan_alt: Dr. Lin Shu-fen, fictional Taiwanese chief cleanroom officer and Ark commander in her late thirties, composed alert expression, glossy black hair tucked into a sterile suit cap, slim rimmed glasses; clean pale cleanroom-style EVA suit with restrained red and blue shoulder accents, no flag; a gowning airlock glowing soft white behind her, a tray of silicon wafers cradled in gloved hands and a mist-green mountain ridge beyond a viewport.
thailand_alt: Anan Wongsakul, fictional Thai Ark rice agronomist in his mid-fifties, round friendly face, warm golden-brown skin, thinning grey-black hair and a gentle crinkled smile; light ivory habitat suit with restrained red, white and deep-blue shoulder accents, no flag; a handful of green rice seedlings held in one palm, flooded hydroponic paddies shimmering in terraced greenhouse bays behind him.
singapore_alt: Dr. Ravi Pillai, fictional Singaporean water systems director and Ark commander in his mid-fifties, calm precise expression, short grey-streaked black hair, neat salt-and-pepper mustache; spotless white and graphite EVA suit with restrained red and white shoulder accents, no flag; a bank of clear reclamation tanks and a tangle of gleaming pipes lit blue behind him, a tablet of flow diagrams in his hand.
philippines_alt: Ramón Villanueva, fictional Filipino chief bosun and Ark commander in his late forties, stocky build, sun-browned skin, thick black hair with a grey forelock and a booming laugh; practical ivory deck suit with restrained blue, red and yellow shoulder accents, no flag; a coil of mooring rope over one shoulder and a battered guitar slung on his back, a crowded dust-skiff dock with strings of cheerful lights behind him.
vietnam_alt: Nguyễn Quang Huy, fictional Vietnamese chief dike engineer and Ark commander in his early fifties, wiry frame, tanned angular face, steady patient eyes, short black hair flecked with grey; muddy olive-grey EVA suit with restrained red and yellow shoulder accents, no flag; a muddy survey staff in one hand, a long earthen embankment with sluice gates holding back a rust-colored flood channel behind him.
bangladesh_alt: Dr. Imran Chowdhury, fictional Bangladeshi river pilot-general and Ark commander in his late thirties, lean energetic face, brown skin, short black hair and a quick confident grin; durable waterproof ivory EVA suit with restrained green and red shoulder accents, no flag; a slim river skiff with a glowing depth gauge moored behind him in a braided dust-delta channel, an amber monsoon-warning beacon above.
malaysia_alt: Hafiz Abdullah, fictional Malaysian Ark chief interpreter in his early thirties, bright friendly eyes, warm brown skin, neat short black hair and a quick easy smile; soft ivory suit with restrained red, blue and yellow shoulder accents, no flag; a translation headset around his neck and a steaming tea glass in hand, a lantern-lit communal hall with a rainforest greenhouse canopy behind him.
